question: Can the pinned NautilusTrader BacktestNode/ParquetDataCatalog path replay PMXT Polymarket tick_size_change rows as timed InstrumentAny instrument-definition epochs without Bolt-owned simulation behavior?
answer: No. Pinned NT can store multiple InstrumentAny snapshots in ParquetDataCatalog and its live Polymarket adapter rebuilds BinaryOption instruments on tick_size_change, but standard BacktestNode catalog replay schedules only Data enum rows through BacktestDataConfig. InstrumentAny is loaded up front through query_instruments/add_instrument and is not a NautilusDataType or Data variant, so tick-size-changing PMXT L2 assets cannot be accepted through ordinary BacktestNode catalog replay.

audited_sources.evidence: The backtesting proof crate pins nautilus-backtest, nautilus-persistence, nautilus-polymarket, nautilus-model, and nautilus-trading to rev 6e059dcbb59ac1e582132fc431a581936c216c3c.

NautilusDataType variants are QuoteTick, TradeTick, Bar, OrderBookDelta, OrderBookDepth10, MarkPriceUpdate, IndexPriceUpdate, InstrumentStatus, and InstrumentClose. There is no InstrumentAny replay data type.

BacktestDataConfig selects a NautilusDataType plus catalog path, instrument ids, time bounds, filter expression, client id, and bar query fields. It has no field for timed instrument-definition replay.
BacktestNode queries catalog instruments for each BacktestDataConfig during engine setup and calls engine.add_instrument before loading market data.
BacktestNode load_data dispatches BacktestDataConfig to ParquetDataCatalog query calls for the NautilusDataType variants only; InstrumentAny is not dispatched.
The Data enum includes Delta, Deltas, Depth10, Quote, Trade, Bar, MarkPriceUpdate, IndexPriceUpdate, InstrumentStatus, InstrumentClose, and Custom. It does not include InstrumentAny.
BacktestEngine.add_instrument can apply an InstrumentAny directly, but it is a direct setup call, not a BacktestDataConfig replay stream.
BacktestEngine.add_data accepts Vec<Data>; scheduled replay batches cannot contain InstrumentAny.
The backtest run loop advances through BacktestDataIterator Data rows and calls DataEngine.process_data for each scheduled row.
DataEngine.process can handle dynamically typed InstrumentAny, but this is outside the Data enum replay path used by BacktestDataConfig.
DataEngine.process_data handles Data::InstrumentStatus and Data::InstrumentClose, but there is no Data::InstrumentAny branch.
ParquetDataCatalog.query_instruments calls query_instruments_filtered with no start/end time bounds, so BacktestNode's instrument loading does not select a timed instrument epoch.
NT tests prove ParquetDataCatalog can write/read multiple timestamped InstrumentAny versions for the same instrument id, confirming storage support but not BacktestNode replay support.
The live Polymarket adapter handles tick_size_change by rebuilding the instrument and sending DataEvent::Instrument.
The live tick-size-change test asserts that a rebuilt instrument event is emitted and no Data event is emitted for the tick-size change.

not_the_issue: ParquetDataCatalog ability to store multiple InstrumentAny snapshots
root_cause.actual_blocker: Standard BacktestNode catalog replay separates up-front InstrumentAny loading from scheduled Data replay. PMXT tick_size_change semantics require a timed instrument-definition epoch, but the pinned NT BacktestDataConfig/Data path has no InstrumentAny stream.

approved_next_paths.claim_limit: Can prove PMXT OrderBookDelta/TradeTick catalog read-back and BacktestNode execution only for source-proof-selected assets/windows with tick_size_change_rows == 0. It cannot prove full PMXT L2 acceptance.

Would be outside ordinary BacktestDataConfig catalog replay and must prove no custom simulator behavior, correct timestamp ordering, cache/exchange state transitions, result provenance, and CI coverage.
Can advance BTE-022 by proving another accepted source/data family maps cleanly to NT catalog classes and BacktestNode input without the timed InstrumentAny blocker.

rejected_paths.reason: This would silently drop required instrument epoch semantics and overclaim L2 replay correctness.
This rewrites historical book price precision and can change admissibility/fill semantics before the tick-size-change event.
InstrumentStatus and InstrumentClose are replayable Data variants but do not update price_increment or price_precision on InstrumentAny.

next_required_evidence: For PMXT first proof, bind the source proof to a selected instrument/window with tick_size_change_rows == 0 and explicit claim limits.
For full PMXT L2 acceptance, design and prove a timed InstrumentAny replay mechanism or wait for an NT BacktestDataConfig/Data surface that supports instrument-definition epochs.
For BTE-022 closure, prove at least one accepted source sample maps to NT-compatible catalog classes and BacktestNode input without unresolved source semantics.
